SELECT DISTINCT SHIMEDYDM || SHIMEDD AS SKYDD, SZDT.SKYSHONO, SZDT.TOKUISAKICD, TKSM.TOKUISAKINMN1, SZDT.KONKAITAXNUKIURIKIN + SZDT.KONKAISHOHITAXKIN AS TOTSUKIURIKIN, SZDT.KESHIKOMIZD, SZDT.SHRYTIDYDMDD, SZDT.KESHIKOMIKIN FROM S10T004T NKRT INNER JOIN S07T001T SZDT ON NKRT.APKIHONCD = SZDT.APKIHONCD AND NKRT.SHOPCD = SZDT.SHOPCD AND NKRT.SKYSAKICD = SZDT.SKYSAKICD AND NKRT.TOKUISAKICD = SZDT.TOKUISAKICD AND NKRT.SHOKAISKYSHONO = SZDT.SKYSHONO LEFT JOIN S02M013T TKSM ON SZDT.APKIHONCD = TKSM.APKIHONCD AND SZDT.SHOPCD = TKSM.SHOPCD AND SZDT.TOKUISAKICD = TKSM.TOKUISAKICD WHERE NKRT.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NKRT.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NKRT.NYKNDNPYNO = #{nykndnpyono,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NKRT.YUKOKBN = '1' AND NKRT.SHOKAISKYSHONO IS NOT NULL AND NKRT.KSHKMNYKNKIND <> 30 AND NKRT.KSHKMNYKNKIND <> 31 AND SZDT.YUKOKBN = '1' ORDER BY SZDT.SHIMEDYDM || SZDT.SHIMEDD, SZDT.TOKUISAKICD

SELECT NKKR.SHOKAISKYSHONO , NKKR.NYKNKIND , NKKR.KESHIKOMIKIN AS NKKRKESHIKOMIKIN , SKYZ.KESHIKOMIKIN AS SKYZKESHIKOMIKIN , SKYZ.KESHIKOMIZD AS SKYZKESHIKOMIZD FROM ( SELECT NK.APKIHONCD , NK.SHOPCD , NK.SKYSAKICD , NK.TOKUISAKICD , NK.SHOKAISKYSHONO , DECODE(NM.NYKNKIND, '31', '31', '01') AS NYKNKIND , SUM(NK.KESHIKOMIKIN) AS KESHIKOMIKIN FROM S10T004T NK INNER JOIN S10T001T NM ON NM.APKIHONCD = NK.APKIHONCD AND NM.SHOPCD = NK.SHOPCD AND NM.DNPYNO = NK.NYKNDNPYNO AND NM.NYKNDNPYNOEDANO = NK.NYKNDNPYNOEDANO WHERE NK.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NK.SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NK.NYKNDNPYNO = #{dnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NK.SKYSAKICD = #{skysakicd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NK.TRKSDNPYNO IS NULL AND NK.SHOKAISKYSHONO <> '000000000000' AND NK.YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY NK.APKIHONCD , NK.SHOPCD , NK.SKYSAKICD , NK.TOKUISAKICD , NK.SHOKAISKYSHONO , DECODE(NM.NYKNKIND, '31', '31', '01') ) NKKR LEFT JOIN S07T001T SKYZ ON SKYZ.APKIHONCD = NKKR.APKIHONCD AND SKYZ.SHOPCD = NKKR.SHOPCD AND SKYZ.SKYSAKICD = NKKR.SKYSAKICD AND SKYZ.TOKUISAKICD = NKKR.TOKUISAKICD AND SKYZ.SKYSHONO = NKKR.SHOKAISKYSHONO AND SKYZ.YUKOKBN = '1'

SELECT NR.KESHIKOMIKIN AS NYKNKESHIKOMIHISTORYKESHIKOMIKIN , ZD.KESHIKOMIKIN AS SKYZDKESHIKOMIKIN FROM ( SELECT APKIHONCD , SHOPCD , SKYSAKICD , TOKUISAKICD , SHOKAISKYSHONO , SUM(KESHIKOMIKIN) AS KESHIKOMIKIN FROM S10T004T WHERE APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NYKNDNPYNO = #{dnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND KSHKMNYKNKIND = '31' AND KESHIKOMIKIN > 0 AND TRKSDNPYNO IS NULL AND YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY APKIHONCD , SHOPCD , SKYSAKICD , TOKUISAKICD , SHOKAISKYSHONO ) NR INNER JOIN S07T001T ZD ON ZD.APKIHONCD = NR.APKIHONCD AND ZD.SHOPCD = NR.SHOPCD AND ZD.SKYSAKICD = NR.SKYSAKICD AND ZD.TOKUISAKICD = NR.TOKUISAKICD AND ZD.SKYSHONO = NR.SHOKAISKYSHONO AND ZD.YUKOKBN = '1'

SELECT NR.NYKNDNPYNO AS NYKNDNPYNO, NR.SHOKAISKYSHONO AS SHOKAISKYSHONO, NR.DAIBIKISKYSHONO AS DAIBIKISKYSHONO, NVL(SUM(NR.KESHIKOMIKIN), 0) AS NRKESHIKOMIKIN, NVL(SUM(S1.KESHIKOMIKIN), 0) AS S1KESHIKOMIKIN, NVL(SUM(S2.KESHIKOMIKIN), 0) AS S2KESHIKOMIKIN, NVL(SUM(S1.KESHIKOMIZD), 0) AS S1KESHIKOMIZD, NVL(SUM(S2.KESHIKOMIZD), 0) AS S2KESHIKOMIZD FROM S10T004T NR LEFT JOIN S07T001T S1 ON ( NR.APKIHONCD = S1.APKIHONCD AND NR.SHOPCD = S1.SHOPCD AND NR.TOKUISAKICD = S1.TOKUISAKICD AND NR.SHOKAISKYSHONO = S1.SKYSHONO ) LEFT JOIN S07T001T S2 ON ( NR.APKIHONCD = S2.APKIHONCD AND NR.SHOPCD = S2.SHOPCD AND NR.TOKUISAKICD = S2.TOKUISAKICD AND NR.DAIBIKISKYSHONO = S2.SKYSHONO ) WHERE NR.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NR.SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NR.NYKNDNPYNO = #{uridnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NR.SKYSAKICD = #{skysakicd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NR.TOKUISAKICD = #{tokuisakicd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( NR.SHOKAISKYSHONO = #{skyshono, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR NR.DAIBIKISKYSHONO = #{skyshono, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND NR.YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY NR.NYKNDNPYNO, NR.SHOKAISKYSHONO, NR.DAIBIKISKYSHONO
